item.title: Healthcare Navigation in Anne Arundel County
item.description:
Healthcare Navigation in Anne Arundel County

Estimated reading time: 5 minutes

Moving to a new area means figuring out healthcare from scratch. You need a primary care doctor, maybe a specialist, and you need to know where to go when things go wrong. Here’s what’s known about navigating healthcare in Anne Arundel County.

Where People Actually Get Care

Anne Arundel Medical Center

The main hospital for the county is Anne Arundel Medical Center (AAMC) in Annapolis. It’s a 507-bed acute care hospital with emergency services, maternity care, cardiac care, and a full range of medical services.

Anne Arundel County Healthcare & Hospitals

Anne Arundel County has excellent healthcare facilities, from major hospitals to specialized clinics. This guide covers where to go for different medical needs.

Major Hospitals

Anne Arundel Medical Center (AAMC)

Main Hospital Location: 600 N Conway Street, Annapolis, MD 21401
Phone: 410-571-5000
Emergency: 410-571-5000 (call 911 for emergencies)
Website: www.aamc.org

Services:

  • 24/7 Emergency Room
  • Trauma Center (Level III)
  • Maternity and obstetrics
  • Cardiology services
  • Cancer center
  • Orthopedics
  • Neuroscience
  • Pediatric care
  • Surgery services
  • Imaging and diagnostics

item.title: Tricare Health Insurance for Military Families
item.description:
Tricare Health Insurance for Military Families

If you’re military or a military family member living in Anne Arundel County, Tricare provides your health insurance. This guide covers your options near Fort Meade, Naval Academy, and Joint Base Andrews.

Tricare Options

Tricare Prime

Best For: Active duty service members and families

Features:

  • No monthly premium (for service members)
  • $0-200 per person annual enrollment fee (for families)
  • Choose primary care manager (PCM)
  • Referrals needed for specialists
  • Low copays for care
  • Comprehensive coverage

item.title: Pediatric Care in Anne Arundel County
item.description:
Pediatric Care in Anne Arundel County

Finding good pediatric care is crucial for your child’s health and development. Anne Arundel County has many pediatric practices serving families throughout the county.

Finding a Pediatrician

When to Start Looking

During Pregnancy:

  • Interview pediatricians while pregnant
  • Many offices have enrollment forms ready
  • Establish relationship before baby arrives
  • Some offer prenatal classes

After Birth:

  • First visit typically 3-5 days after birth
  • Some offices see baby at hospital before discharge
  • Schedule before leaving hospital if possible
